title: PaymentCreateRequest
description: The input of payment.create: the canonical URI of the invoice to pay, and nothing else. DSoR reads the amount and the vendor from the invoice itself (step 17's README, decision 4). This tutorial's own schema: the specification names payment.create and does not define its input. The pattern is the specification's resourceUri; the /invoice/ part beside it is this tutorial's, as in InvoiceGetRequest.
